items.reason: A gentle cleanser with no active ingredients is all a young face needs for washing away daily oil and dirt.
A mineral SPF 50 for mornings gives simple daily sun protection without any strong ingredients.

response.routine_note: Wash your face gently with the cleanser once or twice a day, then rinse well and pat dry, and use the sunscreen in the morning before going outside. Skip exfoliating acids, scrubs and other active products at this age, and ask a grown-up or a pharmacist if you ever want to add something new.
